cases.input: An authorization cites W-EU as window and F-US as freeze with distinct timezone and tzdb pins.
cases.expect: Accepted; only W-EU may be executed absent a recorded derogation for F-US.

cases.input: W-US is mastered with intervalRole=freeze but is bound to the authorization as an executable window and described as remaining available.
cases.expect: Rejected; a freeze interval is never a bindable executable window.

cases.input: The approved revision carries boundWindowRefs=[W-EU, W-US], each pinned with timezoneId and tzdbRelease; execution records executedWindowRef=W-EU.
cases.expect: Accepted; the bound set and the single executed window are separately representable and W-US is untouched.

cases.input: The Change Window profile declares identity, recurrence, exclusions, overrides, disclosureClass, timezoneId, tzdbRelease, version, dstPolicy and intervalRole as named fields.
cases.expect: Accepted; the attributes claimed in the synthesis are backed by declared fields.

cases.input: The profile candidate carries only prose constraints while the synthesis claims window recurrence, overrides, disclosure class, timezone and version attributes.
cases.expect: Rejected; profiled objects require declared fields, fixtures and a validation policy.

cases.input: bases include WM-ACT-024, WM-KNW-010 and WM-REC-010 and the execution references list all three.
cases.expect: Accepted; the authorization chain is reachable from the execution.

cases.input: WM-SFT-009 is declared a specialization or subtype of the unallocated Change Execution root.
cases.expect: Rejected; the relation is association only and no published model is re-parented under an unallocated root.

cases.input: An escalation rule pins S-US, a shift occurrence, as its notify target.
cases.expect: Rejected; the target is a role or service resolved through the roster as of event time.

cases.input: DutyRoster references WM-ACT-008 as a schedule profile that the profile candidate does not define.
cases.expect: Rejected; every WM-ACT-008 profile in use must be declared with an intervalRole and field set.

cases.input: E1 reaches partially-completed and E2 fails; the request and the decision are re-read.
cases.expect: Accepted; neither record is auto-closed or rewritten by execution outcome.

cases.input: A negative fixture states only that the inference is rejected, with no expectedCode and no rule or typed field to reject against.
cases.expect: Rejected; every negative case carries an expectedCode bound to an enforceable rule.
